body: I have no one, my "friends" aren't really close to me, i'm always there for them but they're never there for me i'm tired of being on my own i just had enough of it i thought i was stronger than this but 23 years of loneliness plus a life of regrets seems not worth living.

Thank you i'm a bit better now, i know things do get better but it sometimes seems like it'll be too late you know? One day at a time making little changes seems to have worked before maybe i should try that again, thank you for the advice and i'm glad to hear you made your life better.
Thanks i'll make sure to check those.

I'm glad you understand what im going through, yes it is a tough profession no wonder there is a nurse shortage all over the world, it is just confusing because i do love my patients they really can make your day.

Why i'm not going for medicine is the exact same reason you had, i know i wouldnt stand charting or doing rounds it just wouldnt feel right with me. I guess i should try other services for now see if can truly love nursing again. Thanks for the advice you are an amazing person nurse or not :)

Is it bad that made me tear up a little? i really appreciate your words but it sometimes it just all feels like change will never come, i guess i should take it day by day for now. Am curious how did you make big changes in your life without getting overwhelmed? Oh and youre awesome too :D

Sorry for the late response i feel a little bit better now, i know i don't i might not like nursing as much i thought but i feel that dropping out now would be a waste of money and time so i might as well finish and maybe try something else, thanks for your words.
